_readme: All tunable inputs for the Week Ahead engine. Mode 'hotel_median' (live): the comp-set median of the site's weekly comparable hotel rates (data/comps.json) is the Studio-equivalent baseline; each plan = baseline x realization x position index x plan ratio to S1 (document base ADRs). Values marked NEEDS_INPUT still need Callum's confirmation. See README.

base_occupancy.label: Historical base: 73% with size step-down
base_occupancy.method: base occupancy(plan) = anchor x (1 - occupancy_model.d) ^ size_units (same step and den weight as the estimate, its own anchor)
base_occupancy._note: S1 73.0%, A1 70.1%, A2-A4 68.7%, B2/B3 67.3%, B1 65.9%, C1 64.6%. Base RevPAU = document base ADR x base occupancy(plan). Because both step down by the same factor, RevPAU vs base = (1 + ADR vs base) x (occ_studio / anchor) - 1, i.e. it reflects both rates and the higher estimated occupancy anchor.

occupancy_model.formula: Occ(plan) = occ_studio x (1 - d) ^ size_units;  size_units = bedrooms + den_weight x has_den
occupancy_model.occ_studio_status: anchor for the live estimate: 83%, the document's original occupancy (Callum, Oct 21, 2026). Decoupled from the historical base (base_occupancy.anchor).
occupancy_model._note: Estimated occupancy(plan) = occ_studio x (1 - d) ^ size_units; size_units: Studio 0, 1 Bed 1, 1 Bed + Den 1.5, 2 Bed 2, 2 Bed + Den 2.5, 3 Bed 3. With occ_studio 0.83: S1 83.0%, A1 79.7%, A2-A4 78.1%, B2/B3 76.5%, B1 74.9%, C1 73.4%. d and den_weight are shared with the historical base.
occupancy_model.label: Estimated occupancy: 83% with size step-down

pipeline._stale_days: Comp records whose observation date is more than this many days before as_of (or after it) are dropped as stale.
pipeline._iqr: Records outside [Q1 - k*IQR, Q3 + k*IQR] are trimmed per unit type. Only applied when a type has at least iqr_min_n clean comps.
pipeline._median_min_n: With this many clean comps or more, the point estimate is the median. Below it (but at least gap_fill_min_n) it is a trimmed mean that drops the single highest and lowest comp.
pipeline._gap_fill_min_n: Below this many clean comps, the type is derived from the best-supported type (label 'Derived').
pipeline._flag: Flag the week when |mean - median| / median exceeds this %, computed on the de-duplicated, non-stale set before IQR trimming (so outliers show up in the diagnostic).

_unit_types: realization and position_index: NEEDS_INPUT, kept at 1.00 (no haircut, parity). In hotel_median mode they multiply the comp-median baseline for every plan of that type. In unit_type_feed mode realization applies to listed records only.
_layouts: layout_index is only used by the per-unit-type feed mode (unit_type_feed); hotel_median mode uses the plan ratio to S1 (document base ADRs) instead. Occupancy is no longer set per plan here: see occupancy_model.

gap_fill._ratios: Size ratios vs Studio, defaulted from the document's base-scenario ADRs of each type's reference layout (A1 $409, B3 $552, C1 $658 vs S1 $338). The spec's 1.80 Studio-to-2BR ratio was illustrative. NEEDS_INPUT.
gap_fill._power: If method = 'power', ADR_t = ADR_anchor * (sqft_t / sqft_anchor) ** power_beta using reference-layout sqft. power_beta must be set (no default).

hotel_median.per_hotel_statistic: median of the hotel's priced nights in the week
hotel_median._note: Plan ratios are computed from units.json base ADRs (S1 338, A1 409, A2 449, A3 504, A4 510, B1 589, B2/B3 552, C1 658), so they update if the document figures are replaced.

_modes: hotel_median (default, live): built from data/comps.json. unit_type_feed: a future per-unit-type STR comp feed (CSV/JSON) via update_week_ahead.py --feed ...
